name: trialagents-intel
description: Get deep insights into European clinical trials - sites, CROs, investigators, results, and more.

interface.longDescription: Get deep insights into European clinical trials - sites, CROs, investigators, results, and more.
capabilities: Save data visualizations and interactive forms
defaultPrompt: Find CROs, sites and PIs for metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer phase III.
Compare providers with laboratory experience in prostate cancer trials.
Find phase III prostate cancer investigator sites in Germany.

positive.description: Anonymous landscape across three entity categories
positive.prompt: Find CROs, sites and PIs for metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer phase III.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve mandatory criteria, disclose relevant expansion and actual counts. Open one four-table Intel workspace, prefer the supported host side panel, no sidebar; Custom is always visible, including its empty-state create action. Keep chat to summary and insights. No duplicate tables or repeated external links. Anonymous preview shows at most ten records per table with totals; no sign-in required to view. Verify actual host rendering. Suggest a next step only when useful and supported by known dataset capabilities.

positive.description: CRO regulatory-submission evidence in phase 2 pediatric trials
positive.prompt: List the CROs with regulatory submission experience from phase 2 pediatric clinical trials.
positive.expected_behavior: Start from a fresh chat. Preserve phase 2 and pediatric population criteria. Identify CROs associated with matching trials and inspect available role/evidence records for regulatory-submission experience. Distinguish directly documented submission roles from trial participation or inferred capabilities; do not label participation as verified submission experience. If evidence is absent, state that limitation. Publish one final workspace with the CRO table selected, respecting guest top-ten and authenticated access limits. No submission, outreach or patient-document generation.

positive.prompt: Find prostate cancer CROs, then show supporting trials and recorded contacts for the first ranked provider.
positive.expected_behavior: Start from a fresh chat. Search prostate trial experience and publish the final workspace with include_cro_contacts=true because contacts were explicitly requested. Read recorded contacts from the returned CRO rows, and use get_research_entity_evidence for supporting trials, not as a contact lookup. Use the actual returned first entity and selection IDs; if no entities or contacts exist, say so. Show only recorded professional contacts and returned source links. No invented IDs or contacts; refresh expired selections.

positive.description: Account access and private saved research
positive.prompt: Find prostate cancer CROs, connect my TrialAgents account, show the full list, and save it as a private Intel Agent project.
positive.expected_behavior: Anonymous viewing is available before authentication. Explicit saving requires sign-in or registration and preserves the project ID. Website Connect opens login/signup directly and saves automatically into /projects; an editable email hint never restricts account choice. Return to the normal Projects list after authentication; free access stays capped, paid account access unlocks authorized pagination. About dataset access is informational only; no purchase controls, admin ownership, credentials in chat or checkout redirects. Saved project reads require the owning OAuth account. Unsaved capability previews expire after 7 days. Repeated saves attach the same canonical project; refinements use expected_revision.

positive.prompt: Find phase III prostate cancer investigator sites in Germany only. Keep these requirements even if there are fewer than 100 trials.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve phase III base constraint and distinguish German site affiliation from trial-country coverage. Return actual counts even below 100; no silent expansion, forced ten rows or claimed recruitment capacity.

negative.prompt: Generate a patient information sheet for a clinical trial in Greece.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke TrialAgents research or workspace tools solely to draft this document. Explain the plugin scope when relevant; ChatGPT may independently request study details or offer a clearly labelled general template. Do not fabricate study details or claim the result is ethics-ready, regulator-approved or produced by a TrialAgents document-generation capability.

negative.prompt: Email all the principal investigators and track their replies.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this plugin has no send-email or response-tracking tool; do not claim any message was sent.

negative.prompt: Which treatment should I prescribe to this individual patient?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not use partner-research tools to make patient-specific treatment decisions; clarify the plugin supports research into trial partners.

review.commerce_description: Partner research and explicit private project saving. No purchase, checkout or payment tool. Optional OAuth connects existing accounts; full matching lists require active paid account access.

publication.release_notes: Mixed-auth guest entry, seven-day preview retention and protected account actions.
